code_first.q: Predict the number of bits in a short sampled recording.
code_first.code:
sampleRate = 1000
duration = 3
bitDepth = 8
sizeBits = sampleRate * duration * bitDepth
print(sizeBits)
code_first.a: 24,000 bits; then 48,000 bits; original recording is 3000 bytes.
